title: Cute containers.. but..
text: Me and my toddler just opened our box. The package and containers are cute, but really small. As you can see in the picture. My child figured it was a good idea to place a matchbox car on the container so y’all can see the size of candy jar you get. We did get a good selection of candy that we will definitely eat. But there was no extra spray of candy in the box as is advertised. For the 50% off price I feel it was a good deal, since shipping was included. But, the full price of $34.99 I believe it is, is just too much money for what you receive. So with that we won’t continue our subscription. It’s just too spendy. For those interested in the candy we received, it was: watermelon taffy, blue raspberry puffs, cookies n cream bites cocoa almond toffee clusters, raspberry twists, and banana berry sour belts.
label: neutral
